changeSet.author: Artem Prokudin
Artem Prokudin
changeSet.sql:
alter table user add column idp_issuer varchar(255) null, add column idp_subject varchar(255) null, add unique key ux_user_idp_identity (idp_issuer, idp_subject);
update user set idp_subject = substring_index(external_id, '_', -1), idp_issuer = substring(external_id, 1, char_length(external_id) - char_length(substring_index(external_id, '_', -1)) - 1) where external_id like '%/realms/%';

rollback.sql: alter table user drop index ux_user_idp_identity, drop column idp_issuer, drop column idp_subject;

changeSet.author: Artem Prokudin
changeSet.sql: insert ignore into education_resource_user (user_id, education_resource_id, external_id, full_name, email) select u.id, er.id, substring(u.external_id, char_length(er.url) + 2), u.first_name, u.email from user u join education_resource er on u.external_id like concat(er.url, '\_%');

changeSet.author: Artem Prokudin
changeSet.sql: alter table user drop index external_id_hidx, drop column external_id, drop column external_user_id;

rollback.sql:
alter table user add column external_id varchar(255) null, add column external_user_id varchar(255) null, add index external_id_hidx (external_id);
update user u join education_resource_user eru on eru.user_id = u.id join education_resource er on er.id = eru.education_resource_id set u.external_id = concat(er.url, '_', eru.external_id), u.external_user_id = eru.external_id;
